configuration: verification/front_relax with the input.mxl overlay: the same 1x32x25 zonally symmetric y-z channel but on a much coarser and deeper grid (100 km in both horizontal directions, ten 20 m levels on top of fifteen stretched levels down to 2 km, flat bottom from topog.bin) representing a 200 m thick, exactly unstratified mixed layer sitting on a stratified warm bowl, started from t_ini.bin, s_ini.bin and a geostrophic u_ini.bin, with a linear equation of state, temperature as the only buoyancy-carrying tracer and salinity as a passive dye (sBeta=0), no surface forcing, f-plane at f0=1e-4, biharmonic lateral viscosity viscA4=12e5, linear bottom drag, and a vertical diffusivity profile diffKrNrT=diffKrNrS that is 1e-2 in the top six levels and 2e-5 below, so that the mixed layer stays mixed; pkg/gmredi runs in its default skew-flux form with GM_background_K=1000 setting both the GM and the Redi coefficient, GM_maxSlope=1e-2 and, the whole point of this deck, GM_taper_scheme='fm07', the Ferrari and McWilliams 2007 transition-layer scheme with GM_facTrL2dz=0 and the package defaults GM_facTrL2ML=5 and GM_maxTransLay=500 m, which needs a mixed-layer depth and therefore hMixCriteria=-0.1; cAdjFreq=-1 makes model/src/convective_adjustment.F run every step; the window is 24 steps of 3600 s, one day, one step less than the upstream 25. The overlay's -86400 s surfDiag snapshot stream (GM_hTrsL, GM_baseS, GM_rLamb, MXLDEPTH) is not graded: pkg/diagnostics/diagnostics_write.F evaluates a negative-frequency (snapshot) stream at myTime - deltaTClock and writes it during the following step under the previous iteration's suffix: measured natively on 2026-09-05, a 25-step run writes surfDiag.0000000024 while the final state dump carries iteration 25 (retained under comment/fault-probes), so no window makes a snapshot land on the final iteration and the snapshot streams are not graded; the check grades the state dump alone, and the taper is seen through the state it feeds.. Graded: every <field>.<final iteration>.data written by the end-of-run state dump (the prognostic fields of write_state.F and of the packages in use), read with the shape and precision of the .meta sidecar; the initial-state dump and the log are not graded.
observable: every graded field of the final state dump after 24 steps (T and the other prognostic and package fields written at the final iteration), all cells
default_vs_upstream: nTimeSteps 24 (upstream 25); dumpFreq, pChkptFreq, chkptFreq 0 with dumpInitAndLast; writeBinaryPrec 64; useSingleCpuIO; useSingleCpuIO=.TRUE. in data
variant: ic/variant is ic/nominal with GM_background_K=1000.0000000000002 in data.gmredi instead of 1000, replacing the deck's own line: two ulps of the graded precision (2.3e-16 relative) on a parameter that enters the tendency from the first step, verified to be a distinct double, so the two runs differ at round-off level without leaving the round-off floor; the recorded spread is the check's real sensitivity under this rule.

warrant: The observable is every cell of every prognostic field in the final state dump, compared as |c - r| <= 1e-10 + 1e-08|r|; the relative part is the working bound because the graded fields span many orders of magnitude, the absolute part covers cells at or near zero. The observable is every cell of the final state dump, U, V, W, T, S, Eta, PH and PHL, plus the surface-diagnostics snapshot the -86400 s stream writes at the final iteration, compared relatively with an absolute floor. The bound is physical because with no forcing and no resolved eddies the evolution over one day is a deterministic functional of the tensor and of the taper: the mixed layer, the transition layer and the stratified interior each get a prescribed slope treatment and every fault above displaces the result by parts in a hundred or worse. It is achievable in the sense that the deterministic parts of the step are clean: the barotropic solve is set to cg2dTargetResidual=1e-13 on a 32-point domain so its iteration count is very unlikely to move, the flow is two-dimensional in y and z so baroclinic instability cannot grow, and every tensor and tridiagonal evaluation is fixed-length direct arithmetic. Two discrete mechanisms nevertheless exist and both are handled rather than ignored. The first is fm07 itself: gmredi_slope_limit.F sets the base of the transition layer to a cell-interface depth, hTransLay = -depthZ(k+1), the first time a criterion on the accumulated slope is met, so the transition-layer depth and the baseSlope and recipLambda stored with it are level-quantised and can only move in whole levels. That stream is not graded at all (its snapshot never carries the final iteration, see the configuration), so those three level-quantised diagnostics never enter the comparison; the taper they parameterise is fully graded through the prognostic state, and if a level ever does flip, the state itself will show it, which is the honest outcome rather than a hidden one. The one hazard this family of decks carries, and the reason the earlier survey wanted to exclude them, is cAdjFreq=-1: model/src/convective_adjustment.F runs every step and model/src/convective_weights.F decides cell by cell, on the strict sign test (rho(k)-rho(k-1))*rkSign*gravitySign < 0, whether to replace two adjacent cells by their volume-weighted mean. That is a discrete switch, but in this configuration its effect is very nearly continuous, and that is what makes the check defensible. Salinity is a passive dye with sBeta=0, so density is a function of temperature alone; the switch therefore fires exactly when the temperature difference across the interface changes sign, and at that moment mixing the two cells changes their temperature by half of a difference that is itself zero, so the temperature tendency is continuous across the switch. The only quantity that could jump is salinity, whose vertical gradient is not tied to the criterion; but the initial salinity field of this experiment is exactly uniform in the vertical (it varies with y only), so at the start mixing salinity is an exact no-operation, and the vertical salinity gradients that develop later are small. A perturbed run can therefore flip a marginal interface and the resulting difference is bounded by the local tracer jump rather than by anything O(1). This is an argument, not a measurement, and it is why the window is kept at or below the deck's own step count and why a native scan of the worst relative spread against window length at 6, 12, 24, 48 and 96 steps must be run before the bound is fixed: smooth growth means the window can stay or grow, isolated cells with O(1) differences mean the convective switch is flipping on a real salinity jump and the window must be shortened and the check flagged chaotic. The variant perturbs GM_background_K, which the deck writes explicitly and which sets both the GM and the Redi coefficient, so it enters the tendency of both tracers in every wet cell from the first step; that is the same parameter as the primary front_relax check, which the addendum explicitly permits and which keeps the family comparable. Faults: This is the only check in the suite that exercises a transition-layer taper, so it is where a fault in that machinery shows. Falling back to no tapering, that is using the raw slope inside the mixed layer where fm07 would cut it in linearly, makes the skew flux blow up in the top ten levels where the isopycnals are nearly vertical, an O(1) difference in T and S there. Getting the sign of the D-over-lambda term of the tapering function wrong in gmredi_slope_limit.F flips the sense of the transition and changes the near-surface eddy flux by tens of percent, parts in 1e-1 of the temperature field within a day. A ten percent error in GM_background_K changes the slumping rate by ten percent and the tracers by parts in 1e-3 in the same window. Omitting the MAX that keeps the transition layer at least as thick as the local cell (minTransLay) collapses it onto a single level and changes GM_hTrsL by a whole level, which is seen through the near-surface tracers the taper feeds. Because salinity is a passive dye that only the tensor moves, a fault in the isopycnal as opposed to the skew part shows in S at parts in 1e-2 while leaving T much less disturbed. A single-precision tensor leaves relative errors near 1e-7 in both tracers. The expensive path under test is pkg/gmredi/gmredi_calc_tensor.F, which for fm07 calls pkg/gmredi/gmredi_slope_limit.F three times per level (once for the tensor and once for each horizontal flux component) to build the slope magnitude and direction, locate the base of the transition layer and evaluate the two tapering functions G and G-hat, followed by the tensor application in gmredi_xtransport.F, gmredi_ytransport.F and gmredi_rtransport.F inside model/src/calc_gt.F and calc_gs.F; model/src/calc_oce_mxlayer.F supplies the mixed-layer depth every step and model/src/convective_adjustment.F with convective_weights.F and convectively_mixtracer.F runs its sort-and-mix sweep every step.. The nominal-versus-variant spread recorded by selfcheck is the measurement of the round-off amplification under this exact rule, and the bound is finalised against it with the human.
